label: Holders of the joint-absence power are actual roots, from P2', P3', presence and NAR
description: Argument 1, the first half of the holder-root identification (#1897 gap 2). Not a transcription: the necessity of every holder is derived from P2' and P3' (law 1; #1897 derived it only for some holder). NAR carries exactly the step from necessity to underivedness: its omission model is a necessary holder grounded by the root (Avicenna's necessary through another). Establishes no premise. Omission models: without existence at w, without P2', without P3', without NAR.
